compiled_state.description:
## Summary

Discovered while proving bug `5931-78a3-95d2-44cd` (marker dropped by truncation). The
Cloud outbound comment path fits the SAME body with TWO different rules, so the
body-equality dedup can never match for an over-length comment.

- **Differ / comparison key** — `outbound_comments._diff_comments` computes
  `sanitizer.fit_comment(body)`. Cloud's `_JiraSanitizer.fit_comment`
  (`adapters/jira/backend.py:152-154`) is `comment_limits.truncate_comment_body`, a
  PLAIN-CHARACTER cap at `_JIRA_COMMENT_MAX_CHARS = 32767`.
- **Send path** — `adapters/jira/acli_cli_ops.add_comment` fits with
  `AdfCodec.fit_outbound` -> `adf.fit_text_to_adf_limit`, which measures the SERIALIZED
  ADF against `_ADF_DESCRIPTION_LIMIT = 32000`.

## Runtime evidence

Driving both with a 40,000-char body (worktree `fix-illadopsis-marker`, repo venv):

```
compare key len:      32767
landed jira key len:  31887
BODY-EQUALITY SECONDARY SKIP HITS (today): False
```

The two keys can never be equal for any over-length comment.

## Why it matters

`emersed-specific-mutt` made the ID-based skip (`binding_store.is_comment_mapped` /
`jira_comment_id`) PRIMARY, so this is the belt-and-suspenders layer — but that layer is
exactly the guard against a lost map write (a crash between `add_comment` and
`record_comment_id`). For over-length comments it is structurally dead, so a lost map
write re-posts every pass. `comment_limits.py`'s own docstring states the convergence
requirement this violates: "If the two paths used different truncation logic they could
never agree on the landed body, and the loop would persist."

Not fixed under 5931 — that bug's fix is confined to preserving the marker and does not
change any comparison key. This divergence predates it and is unchanged by it.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The differ's comment comparison key and the Cloud send path apply the identical fit.
- [ ] A test drives both and asserts the landed body equals the comparison key for an
      over-length comment (RED on current code).
compiled_state.title: Cloud comment dedup key is fitted at 32767 while the send path fits at the 32000 ADF limit
